steps.caption: Invoices
steps.narration: This is Invoices. Every invoice across your company is in this one list.

steps.caption: Number, client, title, status, total
steps.narration: Each row shows the number, the client, the title, the status and the total.

steps.caption: Status filters
steps.narration: The status boxes are Draft, Sent, Partial, Paid, Void and Overdue.

steps.caption: Tick Sent
steps.narration: Tick Sent to see the invoices that are out with clients.

steps.caption: 2 of 4
steps.narration: The count shows how many match: two of four.

steps.caption: Add Partial
steps.narration: Add Partial, and you also see the ones that are part paid.

steps.caption: Sort
steps.narration: Sort puts the newest, the oldest or the largest invoices first.

steps.caption: Date range
steps.narration: The date lists keep only today, the last seven days, the last thirty, or a range you choose.

steps.caption: Search
steps.narration: Or search by invoice number or client name.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Click the number, and the client's page opens.

steps.caption: The invoice on the client's page
steps.narration: The invoice is under Invoices, with Resend, Preview and Record payment.

steps.caption: Menu: Invoices
steps.narration: You'll find Invoices in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to find and filter invoices | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the Invoices list in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will filter by status - Draft, Sent, Partial, Paid, Void and Overdue - sort, narrow by date, search by number or client name, and open an invoice on the client's page.
